boundaries: The complete topology-code collision distance is not closed: all weights through three are separated, zero-residual weights below eight are excluded, and an explicit weight-32 relabelling witness gives 8 <= d0 <= 32.
Independent strictly local three-mode permutation jumps do not preserve the W33 fixed algebra; the exact construction compiles global transvections into local macros.
The 24-port controllability certificate is algebraic and does not certify finite-bandwidth, lossy, or robust pulse synthesis.
Safe-learning guarantees use a declared independent-edge observation model rather than measured process-tensor data.
The boot-round count excludes source, detector, classical-compute, memory, and dissipator-settling overhead.
The causal-density model preserves invariant vacuum light speed and does not assert hidden photon nodes or a variable speed of light.
The dual-geometry interferometer and self-similar router are exact graph/control models, not laboratory demonstrations.

3965_topology_code_distance_firewall.boundary: General weight-four syndrome collisions and the exact zero-residual distance within [8,32] remain open.

3966_local_lindbladian_no_go_and_optimal.boundary: The exact jumps are global permutations compiled into disjoint three-cycles; promoting those cycles to independent Lindblad jumps changes the fixed algebra.

3967_dual_geometry_lie_closure.boundary: Necessary and sufficient in the ideal graph-Hamiltonian algebraic model; robust pulse depth and bandwidth remain open.

3968_safe_learning_shield.boundary: Independent-edge concentration model only; no measured process tensor or correlated-error guarantee.
3968_safe_learning_shield.lock_in_rate: O(log(1/delta)/Delta^2) accepted trials when the true parameter is separated from all reliability and cost phase boundaries by Delta.
3968_safe_learning_shield.safe_switch_rule: Switch only when the destination lower-confidence reliability exceeds the target and its upper robust cost plus switch cost is below the source lower robust cost.

3969_self_reproducing_topology_bootloade.boundary: The 221-round count excludes physical source, detector, classical lookup, memory, and dissipator-settling costs.

3970_bonkers_photon_causal_density.boundary: No hidden photon nodes, emergent variable-c law, or identification of time with stored memory is claimed.
3970_bonkers_photon_causal_density.core_law: v=ell/tau; Lorentz-compatible vacuum propagation requires ell/tau=c.
3970_bonkers_photon_causal_density.falsifier: Any claim that hidden node count changes vacuum light speed predicts mode-, frequency-, or encoding-dependent front-arrival delays or Lorentz-violating dispersion.
3970_bonkers_photon_causal_density.margolus_levitin_photon_bound: orthogonal transitions/s <= 2E/(pi hbar)=4 nu for E=h nu
3970_bonkers_photon_causal_density.surviving_interpretation: Internal serial update depth and external flight time share an energy-time causal budget; increasing node count at fixed length requires faster internal ticks rather than changing c.

3971_bonkers_dual_geometry_interferomete.boundary: The passive two-channel interferometer is not universal without the 24-port diagonal symmetry-breaking layer.
3971_bonkers_dual_geometry_interferomete.interpretation: A geometry heterodyne separating common all-to-all transport from W33-specific contrast.

3972_bonkers_self_similar_causal_router.boundary: Logarithmic routing depth does not compress the exponential physical Hilbert-space or mode requirement.
3972_bonkers_self_similar_causal_router.comparison_to_manuscript: The ideal graph diameter 2m is below the manuscript's reversible compiled-routing bound 8m because the latter includes chart and protocol overhead.
